assumption_text: Future disruption remains moderate enough for optimized efficiency to remain viable
revision_rule: Revise if compound disruption exceeds threshold.

assumption_text: Public or institutional finance can support redundancy buffers and adaptive capacity
revision_rule: Stage portfolio if fiscal gap widens.

assumption_text: Institutions can interpret indicators and act on triggers in time
revision_rule: Strengthen governance if trust divergence increases.

assumption_text: Affected groups view transformation as legitimate and materially protective
revision_rule: Expand participation if equity burden rises.

assumption_text: Short-term cost minimization does not create severe future liabilities
revision_rule: Abandon continuity if failure modes intensify.

assumption_text: Precautionary safeguards can keep pace with technology acceleration
revision_rule: Pause high-risk deployment if accountability gap widens.
